product_thesis: Graphene is a local-first mission control for bounded multi-agent coding work. Give it one engineering outcome; it validates a dependency-aware work graph, dispatches only policy-allowed isolated work, adapts to bounded failures, assembles accepted artifacts, verifies the result, and creates an isolated local commit only after explicit approval.
primary_user: A solo developer or small technical lead supervising two to five coding agents against one repository.
costly_problem: The developer becomes the scheduler: preventing conflicting edits, relaying context, noticing failures, integrating outputs, and reconstructing whether the result is safe.
result: A verified review bundle and optional isolated local commit with explicit evidence, resource semantics, and unresolved unknowns.

verified-mission-replay.command: uv run --frozen graphene mission replay taskmaster
verified-mission-replay.truth_label: VERIFIED MISSION REPLAY — GENERATED SCRIPTED FIXTURE; NO LIVE AGENT, HUMAN ATTESTATION, NEW TEST EXECUTION, GEMINI, OR CLOUD
verified-mission-replay.proves: A SHA-256-checked generated mission fixture, deterministic snapshot/delta reconstruction, task evidence drill-down, and the read-only Mission Control experience.

scripted-local.command: uv run --frozen graphene mission start --repo PATH --goal GOAL --driver scripted-local
scripted-local.execute_command: uv run --frozen graphene mission approve-plan MISSION_ID --revision 1
scripted-local.automation_command: uv run --frozen graphene mission start --repo PATH --goal GOAL --driver scripted-local --auto-approve
scripted-local.default_behavior: Persists a validated proposed mission; an interactive TTY may offer plan approval.
scripted-local.truth_label: SCRIPTED LOCAL MISSION FIXTURE — NOT GEMINI, ARBITRARY-REPOSITORY, OR CLOUD PROOF
scripted-local.proves: After plan approval: the validated operational DAG, durable scheduler, two overlapping workers, dependency blocking, fenced leases, one failed check and bounded repair, accepted-only fan-in, assembly, bound verification, and isolated local result mechanics.

adk-fake-planner.truth_label: REAL ADK RUNNER + DETERMINISTIC FAKE PLANNER — NOT GEMINI OR MODEL-WORKER PROOF
adk-fake-planner.proves: Real Google ADK Runner/session plumbing, typed Plan output, a one-call bound, deterministic validation, disabled content telemetry, and sanitized receipts.

gemini-adk-planner.product_command: uv run --frozen graphene mission start --repo PATH --goal GOAL --success-criterion CRITERION --driver gemini-adk
gemini-adk-planner.truth_label: NOT PROVEN — REQUIRES EXPLICIT CREDENTIALS AND A RETURNED GEMINI RECEIPT
gemini-adk-planner.scope: Credentialed model-proposed plan persistence only; worker execution is unavailable.

docker-executor.command: docker build -f docker/executor.Dockerfile -t graphene-executor:py313-pytest . && GRAPHENE_RUN_DOCKER_SMOKE=1 uv run --frozen pytest -q tests/unit/orchestration/test_sandbox.py

mission_capture_boundary.authority: Versioned mission contracts, validated immutable plan revision, append-only hash-chained events, and indexed materialized store state.
mission_capture_boundary.browser_authority: Authenticated read-only public projection; operator changes use the idempotent CLI/store path.
public: bounded task, dependency, worker, gate, policy, state, and blocker labels
template and artifact identifiers plus SHA-256 digests
test, resource, final-result, and explicit-unknown summaries
private_or_excluded: raw prompts, context, hidden reasoning, and chain of thought
raw command arguments, stdout, stderr, source, diffs, and private artifacts
not_observed_or_not_proven: activity outside Graphene-owned workers and explicit evidence adapters
arbitrary user processes or remote CPU and RAM
push, pull request, deployment, or user-branch mutation
live Gemini, Docker, Cloud Run, or Firestore behavior without captured smoke evidence

mission_control_limits.legacy_v2_adapter: reserved; current mission-plan validation rejects legacy_auth_v2
mission_control_limits.replan: records an operator request and pauses dispatch; no linked replacement revision is generated
mission_control_limits.retention: policy metadata is durable; automatic expiry and purge are not implemented
mission_control_limits.cloud_streaming: per-client two-second Firestore polling; no shared listener or fan-out; NOT PROVEN

deferred: linked revision generation after a recorded replanning request and a browser command plane
owned idle STDIO MCP lifecycle cleanup
shared Firestore listener and cloud stream fan-out
live Google Cloud deployment and submission video
